name: Time Language Settings
description: Windows MDM settings in the Time Language Settings category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Block Cleanup Of Unused Preinstalled Lang Packs
properties.description: This policy setting controls whether the LPRemove or Language Packs Uninstaller task will run to clean up language packs installed on a machine but are not used by any users on that machine.

properties.name: Configure Time Zone
properties.description: Specifies the time zone to be applied to the device. This is the standard Windows name for the target time zone.

properties.name: Machine UI Language Overwrite
properties.description: This policy setting controls which UI language is used for computers with more than one UI language installed. If you enable this setting, the UI language of Windows menus and dialogs for systems with more than one language is restricted to the machine language.

properties.name: Restrict Language Packs And Features Install
properties.description: This policy setting restricts the install of language packs and language features, such as spell checkers, on a device.

properties.name: Restrict Language Packs And Features Install (User)
properties.description: This policy setting restricts the install of language packs and language features, such as spell checkers, on a device.
